# TRU-274 PR 0 — Iced stage 4/5 characterization

Pinned base: **`f6df7cae36ac8af2ef758b5619a86ef5f56a6972`**, `origin/v6`
at task creation. All source line anchors below refer to that commit, not
future extracted code. This extends the TRU-284 baseline in
[`../core/CALLERS.md`](../core/CALLERS.md); its expectations are unchanged.
The companion `gpui-stage4-5-design.md` PR row 0 and verification gates are the
scope, not authorization for a behavior move or format migration.

## Harness and observations

`src/stage45/` is included only from the existing `cfg(test)`
`src/baseline_tests.rs` module. It uses the real Iced App methods and update
arms with TRU-284's headless constructor and ordered-effect recorder. Tests
that can touch process-global config run as exact-name subprocesses with a
fresh absolute `GITTERM_V6_CONFIG_DIR`, set before process startup. Snapshot
objects, Git repositories, worktrees, stores and phone registries are disposable.
No environment mutation is shared with parallel tests.

The only other registration is a `cfg(test)` child of `src/task_mcp.rs`, which
can exercise the private dispatcher without exposing its reply constructor.
**No production visibility or behavior changes; no `src/main.rs` changes.**

JSON goldens compare parsed values, not object/map byte order. Inputs and
observations are synthetic. Commit times, author, IDs and transcript dates are
fixed; absolute temporary paths are excluded from observations. Review patch
samples retain the first four lines per file; counts/caps retain large-file
behavior without checking in huge patches. Fixtures are checked-in expectations,
not regenerated by a reducer or automatically blessed on test runs.

## Overlay inventory

`work/overlays.json` is the inventory of `WebviewOverlays` at
`src/main.rs:8213`, mapped from App by `:32723`, consumed by surface selection
at `:8543` and `:32750`. Its test exhaustively destructures the type so a newly
added flag cannot silently escape the inventory. Every flag hides Agent, Page
and Viewer; clearing it restores the Agent when no Viewer is selected.

The 19 entries are Usage, browser evidence, task switcher, task-tab close,
worktree deletion, publish, new task, help, new work, park, parked list, PR
action, ready list, workspace settings, bar menu, tab picker, phone, remote
connect and folder picker. Real WebKit snapshot/scale/focus behavior is a later
stage-4 implementation gate, not something a headless PR 0 asserts.

## Oddities retained

- KeepRunning exists only in memory. Its persisted form is ordinary parked;
  restart cannot infer which processes were previously kept running.
- Aggregate base/commit sources exclude working-tree/untracked changes. Turn
  sources return no live-path pruning set. A first-click pending range already
  collects a diff; completing the range changes pending state separately.
- An unstaged changed submodule receives `commit:0000000000000000000000000000000000000000` from the raw diff; staging supplies its actual commit. This identity oddity is pinned, not corrected.
- Pure renames/mode changes can list with zero text; binary assets classify as
  Code. Admission can omit a submodule patch while still recording its identity.
- Viewed invalidation uses whole-file identity, including text beyond display
  limits. The App refuses malformed marks; the low-level save method itself is
  not a global write-refusal registry.
- Failed ordinary task mutations preserve memory and disk; delivery receipts
  deliberately mutate memory before a failed save to avoid duplicate delivery.
- Settings/tasks/viewed/phone load failures differ from limits/focus/watch/issues/
  guidelines, whose loaders log and return empty/default data. Do not unify
  their error behavior during extraction.
- Find's `ChatPreviewLoaded` caches a late result without checking current
  selection; selection remains separate. Work documents reject absent state,
  whereas failed documents/Usage scans retain their previous result.
- Usage retains negative repo-root lookups in its existing cache: making that directory a repo does not resolve it until a fresh cache is used (`usage/repo-cache.trace.json`).
- Usage applies a stale-window report before scheduling the new window's scan.
  Filters use already-built views; they do not rescan transcripts.
- Work issue keys are filtered by prefixes found in names; a fact's TRU key can
  be absent from the summary when names contain no matching prefix.
- `require_task_tools` rejects Antigravity but accepts an unknown executable;
  acceptance of that predicate is not proof that an arbitrary tool supports MCP.

No PTY/harness, notes commit/push, account CLI, authenticated network operation,
GUI, real config or real credential is exercised by these new fixtures. Process
teardown and GUI scale/keyboard/VoiceOver evidence remain later extraction gates;
existing unit tests are referenced above rather than represented as live proof.
